findings.finding: The Q3 revenue guide of ~$66M was built only from revenue already covered by export permits or not needing one, with upside if more permits arrive. Consensus sits on that floor ($66.0-66.1M, EPS $0.30-0.31 vs a $0.30-0.32 guide). The same construction last quarter ($34M Q2 guide) printed $47.6M, +40% over guide; Q1's $26M guide printed $26.9M. Expected print: ~$68-71M, roughly +3-8% vs the bar, capped by InP capacity (the year-end target is ~$60M a quarter of InP).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rebuilt from confirmed 8-K 2.02 prints only. 2026-07-30 (Q2 +40% over guide, Q3 guide well above consensus): +28.74%. 2026-04-30 (Q1 slightly over guide): +21.18%. 2026-02-19 (Q4'25 revenue miss on fewer permits, -5.5% after hours): +24.65% close-to-close. 2025-10-30: +8.61%. 2025-07-31: -7.69%. The baseline's 2026-04-20 (-4.81, the $550M share offering per RTTNews), 2026-01-09 and 2025-07-09 rows are not earnings. The last four prints averaged about +20.8% (247wallst).
findings.why_not_priced: If the market expected the Q2 pattern to repeat, consensus would sit above the $66M floor (as it sat above $34M before Q2 printed); instead it equals the guide to the decimal, and the stock fell ~28% in the month before the print. The whisper ($0.33 vs $0.30-0.32) and the call skew show only partial pricing.
findings.independence: Same guide construction described independently by the 247wallst preview ('about $66 million already has an export permit or does not need one', https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/26/3-catalysts-that-could-ignite-axti-stock-on-oct-29-and-1-huge-risk/) and the Q1->Q2 guide/actual table at MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/axt-nasdaqaxti-announces-earnings-results-2026-07-31/). Demand corroboration: Lumentum says EML demand exceeds its supply by >30% (https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/lumentum-ceo-says-the-indium-phosphide-shortage-will-become-worse-than-memory); backlog 'well over $100 million'. Counterweight inside the same evidence: China's permit timing is unpredictable (CFO), and Q4'25 missed on permits.

findings.finding: Q4 is the first guide, and Q4 consensus revenue of $77.45M already about equals management's stated year-end capacity: ~$60M a quarter of InP plus other lines at Q2 levels (TIKR's reconstruction). If AXT again guides only from permit-covered revenue, the initial Q4 number can land at or below $77M even with demand intact, and the stock trades on the guide. Permits are the swing: the CFO 'cannot predict' their timing, and Q4'25 missed on 'fewer export permits than expected'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-02-19: a Q4'25 revenue miss attributed to fewer permits traded -5.46% after hours (https://www-web.itiger.com/news/1191453308) but closed +24.65% next day on the Q1 outlook. 2026-07-30: a Q3 guide far above consensus ($66M vs $38.8M) drove +28.74%. The guide has decided the last two reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Each of the last two guides cleared consensus by a wide margin, so the market is used to guide upside; this time consensus already sits at capacity, so the guide-beat channel that carried the last two prints is narrower. If this were priced, the skew would not be call-rich.
findings.independence: Q4 consensus $77.45M also in 247wallst (2026-10-26). Capacity 'about $60M of quarterly InP capacity by year-end, ahead of schedule' in the same 247wallst piece. Inference, not a company statement about Q4; sized small. Against: capacity was being added 'ahead of schedule', and the Oct 28 financing funds more.

findings.finding: On Oct 28 AXT announced up to RMB 3.67bn (~$545M; minimum ~$285M) of private equity into subsidiary Tongmei, led by a 'leading Asia asset manager' with an affiliate of an existing customer among the investors. AXT itself subscribes $400M. AXT keeps ~73.4% at the maximum. Proceeds go to InP capacity and raw-material capacity. The money buys capacity for a demand backlog that customer prepayments corroborate (Coherent $22.3M; Lumentum 2x$43.5M deposits; backlog >$100M), so the sign is positive. Against that: investors get 8% redemption rights if there is no qualifying HK IPO within 3 years, a 13% IRR IPO hurdle, and liquidation preference. Closing is not before December. The stock rose +10.6% on Oct 28, so most of this is priced; the call will be the first time management explains terms and valuation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: April 2026 $550M public offering at $64.25: -12% pre-market (https://www.rttnews.com/story.aspx?Id=3640718). 2026-10-28 Tongmei private round: +10.6% close-to-close (Yahoo history). The market has read this round as funding the ramp, not as dilution.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: +10.6% on the day. What is not priced is management's answer on the call about the valuation of Tongmei in this round and the redemption and preference terms, which the release did not state.
findings.independence: Press release Exhibit 99.1 (same filing, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1051627/000121390026113058/ea030977401ex99-1.htm). Prepayments corroborating the capacity use: Coherent 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001051627/000143774926022557/axti20260630_8k.htm ; Lumentum deposits in goldesel 2026-07-31.

findings.finding: The short interest is large and growing into the print: 11.98M shares at the 10-15 settlement (18.3% of shares outstanding), up 36% since 09-15. Meanwhile the stock fell ~28% in a month on sector de-risking (Oct 8 optics sell-off with COHR -9.6%; Oct 16 and Oct 22 drops of 10-13% with no company news), not on company news. With calls bid (skew -14.6), a clean Q3 beat has a squeeze mechanism behind it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest rose through the Q2 print too (11.0M on 07-15, 10.1M on 07-31), and the stock gained +28.74% that day; on the Q4'25 print a -5.5% after-hours drop reversed to +24.65% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the call skew already pays for upside. Days to cover is only 1.4, so the squeeze is a modest amplifier rather than a forced bid; that is why it is sized small.
findings.independence: The drawdown had no company catalyst: TIKR 2026-10-09 (Oct 8 sector sell-off led by COHR) and Quiver 2026-10-15 (no company announcement). The skew is from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: InP substrate pricing kept rising into Q3. Reports put a 2-inch InP substrate at 500 yuan at end-2025, 880 yuan in June, with a further ~10% increase considered. 247wallst cites a ~10% price increase on AI-laser substrates with the InP line fully utilized, and the CFO said gross margin could eventually 'start with a 5' (Q2: 44.9%). The margin read-through supports EPS at or above the top of the $0.30-0.32 guide. Against it: refined indium is up ~80% YTD, which raises input cost.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 gross margin jumped from 29.6% to 44.9% and EPS beat $0.19 vs $0.07; the stock rose +28.74%. Margin and revenue beats came together, so this line is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: The EPS guide of $0.30-0.32 was set in July, before the further price moves; the whisper of $0.33 prices a little of it. Industry-price proxy, not a company number.
findings.independence: Industry pricing: SCMP and the TrendForce InP shortage piece (https://trendforce.com/news/2026/08/06/news-inp-shortage-emerges-as-ai-optical-interconnect-bottleneck/); SMM indium price +80% YTD (https://news.metal.com/newscontent/104102348-indium-prices-continue-to-rise-smm-indium-spot-weekly-review) cuts the other way on cost. Proxy.

outside_window.finding: The Tongmei private round must close its minimum amount by 2026-12-20 or the subscription agreement terminates; Chinese government filings are required. A failed close would remove the capacity funding.
Coherent reports FQ1 FY27 on 2026-11-04 (guide $2.2-2.4B, InP capacity doubling a quarter early): the first counterparty read on InP supply after AXT prints.
The Tongmei Hong Kong IPO the lead investor is committed to support. If no qualifying IPO happens within 3 years of closing, investors can redeem at 8% a year.

baseline_tension: The long lean agrees with the call-rich skew (-14.6) and the +19.5% 5-day run-up, and cuts against the -24.7% 20-day trend. Agreeing with the skew means part of it is priced, which is why p_up is 60 and not higher.
lessons_applied: Lesson 8 (thin coverage, company-level number, size on the name's own distribution) plus the 'wrong-event history' note: rebuilt the base rate from five confirmed prints (median |move| ~21%) and raised finding 1 from +3.0 to +3.5 and abs_move_pct from 16 to 17.
Lesson 7 (a sign against the skew or into a crowded short): the Q4-guide negative is against a call-rich skew and an 18% short, so it was cut from -1.5 to -1.0.
Lesson 5 and the core's 'proxy' row: the industry-price finding is a proxy with its own cost counterweight (indium +80%), so it was cut from +0.8 to +0.5.
Lesson 7 positioning / lesson 3 (own caveat): the squeeze finding is partly the same information as the skew, and days to cover is 1.4, so it was cut from +1.5 to +1.0.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): answered. The money buys InP capacity corroborated by >$100M backlog and customer prepayments, so the sign is positive. Already priced at +10.6% on Oct 28, so it stays at +0.5.
Lesson 6: bar sourced to the company guide plus two agreeing consensus sources; the Tongmei closing, HK IPO and Coherent print moved to outside_window.
